W58

Course insights and attendance

/teach/courses/:courseId/insights
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: follow-onLegacy: S23

Present source-backed course facts and review attendance corrections without risk scores or inferred absence.

Entry and return
W35 InsightsW48 missing-work viewW32 course session
Layout regions
FactsSubmission before personal close, module completion and dated attendance kept separate
Source detailSession/item, source, capture time and last refresh
Attendance reviewRecorded status, correction request, evidence and immutable history
Fields and validation (5)
FieldTypeRequiredValidationDefaultVisible to

Attendance statusenumNoPresent, Absent, Late, Excused, Not recorded; no inferred conversion—Authorised staff

Source referencetext/referenceYesManual staff entry or named imported sample source and timestamp—Authorised staff
Learner slicescope filterNoTA limited to assigned learners/sessions; no hidden totals—Authorised staff

Dialogs and drawers (1)
Correct attendance entry
  • Original status/source, proposed status, request excerpt and reason
  • Actor/time retained with both versions
Return without applying changesRecord correction
Permissions
  • Instructor reads course facts and approves corrections.
  • TA access requires explicit session/learner scope; grading scope alone does not grant attendance access.
  • No predictive risk labels, institution referral workflow or hidden private notes are included.
Responsive
  • Wide: work/checks side by side. Narrow: labelled stacked sections.
  • At 320px use one panel; tables scroll within labelled regions.
Accessibility
  • Semantic headings/labels, visible focus, text status; restore dialog focus.
  • Link errors to fields; announce saves. Support zoom/reduced motion.
Data
  • Fictional local records; zone/version timestamps.
  • Permission-filter data; uncertain writes remain unconfirmed.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • Unentered sessions are never counted absent.
  • Missing-work count respects personal close and active excuse records.
  • Failed correction keeps original entry and does not display a resolved request.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
